key_impacts: Reactor units at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated and treated; about 1,100,000 m3 stored on-site by Oct 2018.
Fuel debris deposits present in Units 1–3, requiring retrieval.
evidence_snippets: Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011.
Since March 2011, addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi...
As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site.
